instruction: Complete the bubbleSort function in bubbleSort.py on the Desktop. Modify the output format to print each sorted number on its own line without any prefix text. Save the output to 'res.txt' on the Desktop.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened terminal, read the bubbleSort.py template (with #TODO), implemented standard bubble sort, wrote the completed function back, ran the script with 'python3 bubbleSort.py > res.txt', and verified the sorted output [11 12 22 25 34 64 90].
metadata.capability_extraction: Can read docx tutorials in LibreOffice Writer, open terminal, read/write Python files, implement sorting algorithms, run Python scripts, redirect output to files.
metadata.task_rationale: Original task printed space-separated numbers with 'Sorted array:' prefix. This variation requires modifying both the sorting implementation AND the output format, testing the model's ability to adapt the print logic.
metadata.explanation: Task requires implementing bubble sort AND changing output to one number per line. Evaluator checks: (1) full credit if each line is exactly one number in ascending order, (2) partial credit (0.5) if numbers are correct but format differs (e.g., space-separated).
